question: Which program aims to provide houses to the rural poor in India? (RPF Constable 2024 (11/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Skill India
Digital India
Make in India
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana

Explanation:
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) is a flagship housing scheme of the Government of India launched in 2015, aiming to provide pucca houses to all rural and urban poor by 2022. It has two components: PMAY-G (Gramin) for rural areas and PMAY-U (Urban) for urban areas. The scheme provides financial assistance to beneficiaries, with up to ₹1.20 lakh in rural areas and up to ₹2.67 lakh in urban areas. PMAY is implemented under the 'Housing for All' mission, which seeks to ensure every family has a permanent house. The scheme has been successful in increasing housing access and improving living standards for the poor.

☛ What is the objective of PMAY? → Provide pucca houses to all

question: The Sagarmala programme is the flagship programme to promote port-led development in the country through harnessing India’s 7,500 km long coastline. 14,500 km of potentially navigable waterways was approved by the Union cabinet in the year __________. (RPF Constable 2024 (11/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: 2015
2013
2010
2017
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2015

Explanation:
The Sagarmala programme was approved by the Union Cabinet in the year 2015. It is a flagship initiative to promote port-led development, leveraging India's 7,500 km long coastline and 14,500 km of potentially navigable waterways. The programme aims to develop industrial clusters near ports, enhance connectivity, and reduce logistics costs. Key components include port modernization, new waterways, and coastal community development. Sagarmala is integrated with other initiatives like Namami Gange and inland waterway development. The programme is implemented by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.

question: The National Rural Employment Programme (NREP) and the Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP) were merged in April 1989 with the __________ scheme.  (RPF Constable 2024 (12/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Swaran Jyanti Gram Swayamrozgar Yojana
Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY)
Indira Awas Yojna (IAY
Indira Gandhi Swarojgar Yojana
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY)

Explanation:
The National Rural Employment Programme (NREP) and the Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP) were merged in April 1989 into the Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY). JRY aimed at creating employment and developing infrastructure in rural areas. It was implemented through Panchayati Raj institutions. Later, it was subsumed under the Rural Employment Programme (REP). NREP was launched in 1980 and RLEGP in 1983. The merger aimed to create a more effective employment programme. JRY was named after Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru.

☛ When was RLEGP launched? → 1983

☛ After whom is JRY named? → Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru
☛ Which institutions implemented JRY? → Panchayati Raj institutions

question: When was the 20-year road plan introduced in Independent India? (RPF Constable 2024 (17/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: 1961
1975
1965
1952
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1961

Explanation:
The first 20-year road plan (Twenty-Year Road Development Plan) in Independent India was launched in 1961. It is also known as the Nagpur Road Plan. The plan aimed to develop a comprehensive road network across the country, connecting rural areas with urban centers. It set targets for road construction from 1961 to 1981, focusing on increasing road density (length of road per 100 sq km area). The plan was prepared by the Indian Roads Congress (IRC). Subsequently, the second 20-year road plan was initiated in 1981, known as the Bombay Road Plan.

☛ What is the name of the first 20-year road plan? → Nagpur Road Plan
☛ When was the second 20-year road plan introduced? → 1981
☛ What is the name of the second 20-year road plan? → Bombay Road Plan
☛ Which body prepared these plans? → Indian Roads Congress (IRC)
question_hi: स्वतंत्र भारत में 20 वर्षीय सड़क योजना कब शुरू की गई थी? (RPF Constable 2024 (17/03/2025) Shift 1)

Solution: सही उत्तर है 1961

Explanation:

question: Who initiated the Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY)? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (08/08/2025) Shift 1)

solution:

Explanation:
The Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY) was initiated by the Central Government on 25th September 2001. The aim of this scheme was to generate employment in rural areas and provide food security. It was formed by merging the earlier employment schemes like Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY) and Employment Assurance Scheme (EAS). Under SGRY, the target was to provide at least 100 days of employment per year to the rural poor. The financial contribution between the central and state governments was in the ratio of 75:25. Later, in 2006, it was merged into the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA). SGRY focused on rural infrastructure development and employment generation.

question: Which initiative is intended to encourage domestic manufacturing and attract foreign investment? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 3)

question: What was the main aim of IRDP (Integrated Rural Development Programme) ? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 3)
options: To provide free food to rural families
To promote urban employment
To assist poor rural families in acquiring assets or skills for self-employment
To build schools in villages
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is To assist poor rural families in acquiring assets or skills for self-employment

Explanation:
The Integrated Rural Development Programme (IRDP) was launched in 1978-79. Its main aim was to provide self-employment opportunities to rural families living below the poverty line (BPL). The programme helped beneficiaries acquire income-generating assets like livestock, small shops, or skills training. The goal was to increase their income and lift them out of poverty. IRDP was later merged into the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY), which is now part of the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM).

श्यामा प्रसाद मुखर्जी रूर्बन मिशन (SPMRM) वर्ष 2016 में शुरू किया गया था। इसका प्राथमिक उद्देश्य ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में शहरी जैसी बुनियादी सुविधाएं प्रदान करना है, जिससे ग्रामीण अर्थव्यवस्था को बढ़ावा मिले और शहरों की ओर पलायन रुके। यह मिशन ग्रामीण समूहों (क्लस्टर) की पहचान कर उन्हें आवश्यक भौतिक, सामाजिक और आर्थिक बुनियादी ढांचे से जोड़ता है। इसके अंतर्गत सड़क, पानी, बिजली, शिक्षा और स्वास्थ्य जैसी सुविधाओं का विकास किया जाता है। यह मिशन ग्रामीण विकास मंत्रालय के तहत आता है और इसका उद्देश्य ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में संतुलित विकास सुनिश्चित करना है। अन्य विकल्प जैसे विद्युतीकरण या कौशल विकास इस मिशन के अंतर्गत आते हैं, लेकिन प्राथमिक उद्देश्य नहीं हैं।

question: Special Economic Zones (SEZs) were established to promote export-oriented industrialisation. What is a primary incentive offered to firms operating in SEZs? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (13/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: Higher import duties
Strict labour laws
Tax holidays and infrastructure support
Ban on foreign investments
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Tax holidays and infrastructure support

Explanation:
SEZs are special economic zones created to promote export-oriented industries. Firms in SEZs are offered incentives like tax holidays (e.g., income tax exemptions) and better infrastructure (power, roads, ports). The aim is to attract foreign investment and boost exports. The SEZ Act 2005 governs these incentives. Higher import duties, strict labour laws, or ban on foreign investments are not features of SEZs.

☛ What is the main objective of SEZs? → Promote export-oriented industrialisation
☛ Where was India's first SEZ established? → Kandla, Gujarat (as APZ in 1965)
☛ What is a major tax incentive in SEZs? → Income tax exemption
☛ Which ministry administers SEZ policy? → Ministry of Commerce and Industry
question_hi: स्पेशल इकोनॉमिक ज़ोन्स (SEZs) निर्यात-उन्मुख औद्योगीकरण को बढ़ावा देने के लिए स्थापित किए गए थे। SEZs में काम करने वाली फर्मों को दी जाने वाली प्राथमिक प्रोत्साहन क्या है? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (13/08/2025) Shift 1)

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है कर अवकाश और बुनियादी ढांचा समर्थन

Explanation:
SEZs विशेष आर्थिक क्षेत्र हैं जो निर्यात-उन्मुख उद्योगों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए बनाए गए। इनमें फर्मों को कर अवकाश (जैसे आयकर में छूट) और बेहतर बुनियादी ढांचा (बिजली, सड़क, बंदरगाह) जैसी सुविधाएं दी जाती हैं। इसका उद्देश्य विदेशी निवेश आकर्षित करना और निर्यात बढ़ाना है। SEZ अधिनियम 2005 के तहत ये प्रोत्साहन प्रदान किए जाते हैं। उच्च आयात शुल्क, कठोर श्रम कानून या विदेशी निवेश पर प्रतिबंध SEZs की विशेषता नहीं है।

question: When was the Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP) launched? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (13/08/2025) Shift 2)
options: 2 October 1985
15 August 1983
1 April 1980
26 January 1982
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 15 August 1983

Explanation:
The Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP) was launched by the Government of India on 15 August 1983. Its aim was to provide employment to landless workers in rural areas. This programme was launched during the tenure of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. RLEGP focused on developing rural infrastructure such as roads, irrigation, and community buildings. Later in 1989, it was merged with Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY). It was a significant step towards creating employment opportunities for the rural poor.

☛ What was the objective of RLEGP? → To provide employment to landless rural workers
☛ Into which scheme was RLEGP merged? → Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY)
☛ Under which Prime Minister was RLEGP launched? → Indira Gandhi
question_hi: रूरल लैंडलेस एम्प्लॉयमेंट गारंटी प्रोग्राम (RLEGP) शुरू किया गया था? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (13/08/2025) Shift 2)
options_hi: 2 अक्टूबर 1985
15 अगस्त 1983
1 अप्रैल 1980
26 जनवरी 1982
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है 15 अगस्त 1983

Explanation:
ग्रामीण भूमिहीन रोजगार गारंटी कार्यक्रम (RLEGP) भारत सरकार द्वारा 15 अगस्त 1983 को शुरू किया गया था। इसका उद्देश्य ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में भूमिहीन श्रमिकों को रोजगार प्रदान करना था। यह कार्यक्रम तत्कालीन प्रधानमंत्री इंदिरा गांधी के कार्यकाल में लॉन्च किया गया था। RLEGP का फोकस ग्रामीण बुनियादी ढांचे के विकास पर था, जैसे सड़कें, सिंचाई, और सामुदायिक भवन। बाद में 1989 में इसे जवाहर रोजगार योजना (JRY) में मिला दिया गया। यह कार्यक्रम ग्रामीण गरीबों के लिए रोजगार सृजन की दिशा में एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम था।
